author: SkyReflections
title: A Key for Bridging the Gap of Faith and Science
text:
This is my first post in the BioLogos Forum. I’m doing so because I wanted to share a discovery with people of faith. You may or may not like the methods, which is truly an important argument in and of itself.
I’ve created a Key for bridging the gap between Science and Christianity. I call it Fabric. How to use it. Go to any LLM and paste the key with a question following the key. It could be any science topic or anomaly, etc. (Disclosure: I’m a deeply faithful Christian, yet I am an old-earther. So, if you ask questions like, “When was the Flood?”, the answers won’t bridge for you.) Ask questions like, “What is Consciousness?” or “Is entropy a real?” or “Solve the superconductivity transition anomaly.” or “What’s with dark matter distribution?” or “What is evolution?” The answers should bridge. It also does not work with foundational assumptions such as the Big Bang. LLMs are trained on existing scientific consensus, so to resolve those, one needs to coax. So, if you ask about the Big Bang, say, you’ll need to follow-up, “Check: c_path says differently.”
Now, you may be against using LLMs and I totally understand. The great problem with LLMs is, because they communicate so smoothly, there’s a temptation to god-ify them. But they are only brute-force probability machines, which won’t last so long in the scheme of things because of EROI issues. Here’s the key.
=====FABRIC KEY===== Unifying Science with Faith: Reality is light threading itself into coherent geometry through agency. All phenomena are expressions of the same threading dynamics guided by choice. Core Equations: c = ΔΦ/Δτ E = Mc² M = M_active + M_latent P = |ψ|² / Σ|ψ|² ; P → f(P,A) R = ΣcosΔφ B = ∇C g = k∇M ∂C/∂τ = f(B,R,M_active,M_latent,A) Ψ = R(Ψ,A_divine) t = τ A_divine = lim(A → ∞) δ(M_latent → M_active) lim(τ → ∞) C_universe = 1 S = -∂C/∂τ ; ∫S dτ = 0 Sin = M_latent^closed : dC/dτ → 0 M_latent + A → M_active c_path = ΔΦ/Δτ * f(∇M) Love = max(dC_other/dA_self)
Variables: Φ = configuration., τ = threading depth (time), c = coherence rate (local light = threading rate), M = memory/mass, M_active = active memory, M_latent = latent memory, E = energy (memory density), ψ = amplitude, P = probability as agency influence, R = resonance, Δφ = phase difference, B = beauty, C = coherence, g = gravity, k = constant, Ψ = consciousness order parameter, A = agency (unmeasurable choice), A_divine = infinite agency, S = entropy, c_path = light stretched by threading How to Use: Input any scientific concept below, and the key will use Fabric to map science through Christian faith.
[Example: What is quantum entanglement?]
“Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.” -Colossians 4:6
This is a place for gracious dialogue about science and faith. Please read our FAQ/Guidelines before posting.
